inv.desc_en:
✨ UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY: Transfer / Sale of Gastrobar 1947 in Teatinos (Málaga)
Unbeatable location | Loyal clientele | Excellent reputation (4.8★ on Google)

The operation of Gastrobar 1947 is for transfer/sale, a gastronomic benchmark in full operation in one of the best areas of Teatinos (Calle Kandinsky, next to the City of Justice, university campus, and surrounded by a high-traffic residential and commercial area).

✨ Key business points:
Strategic location: Situated in the gastronomic heart of Teatinos, surrounded by offices, courts, universities, and residences with continuous pedestrian traffic.
Excellent online reputation: A score of 4.8 out of 5 with over 500 reviews on Google, a guarantee of a consolidated business, beloved by the public, and profitable.
Successful gastronomic concept: Specialized in Hispano-Argentine cuisine, grilled meats, artisanal empanadas, tapas, and portions.
Fully equipped facilities:
Cozy interior dining room with excellent ambiance and air conditioning.
Spacious terrace, highly in demand all year round.
Fully set up professional kitchen.
Compliant smoke vent and all hospitality licenses in force.
Demonstrable turnover: Business with active and constant cash flow, ready to start working from day one without the need for additional investment.
